pr_title: LE Audio: BSIM broadcast AC testing
pr_body:
Adds testing of the audio configuration for the low latency presets. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/64245

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Expand CAP BSIM tests with data validation
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The tests are currently verifying that the CIS/BIS and can be established, but we never test if data can actually be sent with the providing configurations. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Add data validation (similar to https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/62496) to the CAP AC tests to test that it actually works. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A
